review.description: Reviewed maintain-flow-contracts S3/S4/S5 against main5097e2a7. Complete Python inventories run in bounded independent workers; ownership, cancellation and ordinary unittest skips retain their intended semantics. Each fixture-skipped case is accounted once even when setup and cleanup emit multiple same-scope skip events; every ordinary skip event remains visible. Missing or duplicate non-skipped executions remain failures. Stable IDs, foundational dependency direction, pinned adoption, complete verification and isolated performance thresholds remain unchanged. Target refresh onto5097 preserves all incoming product/foundation mappings; the contributor delta and its assertions remain the tested b311 source bytes. Restored incoming CLI baseline records will be regenerated only after fresh verification.
review.implementation: Reviewed discovered_cases real-object selection and identical inventory digest checks, bounded partitioning, RecordedResult event recording and separate fixture case-ID ledger, exact Counter completeness, process/report success checks and atomic diagnostic publication. super.addSkip retains every standard event while fixture_skipped_ids prevents repeated same-scope setup/cleanup events from double-accounting assigned cases. main reuses authenticated enclosing supervision; source-controlled child entry checks managed ownership/group admission before discovery or mutation. Matching catalog, Make and timing commands retain exact bounded suite deadlines.
review.tests: test_fixture_import_and_method_skips_preserve_unittest_success compares ordinary discovery with one/two workers for class/module/import/method skips and expected failures, including setup plus cleanup SkipTest; it checks each fixture-skipped ID once and all ordinary skip-event counts. test_non_skipped_omissions_and_duplicate_execution_fail_real_workers rejects actual missing/duplicate non-skipped runs alongside a legitimate repeated fixture skip. test_internal_cli_modes_and_unadmitted_bootstraps_reject_before_discovery launches contenders under a healthy independent managed checkout owner and verifies argparse, ownership and group-admission rejection without discovery/report writes. Separately, test_enclosing_timeout_and_cancellation_drain_same_group and test_direct_coordinator_death_retains_supervisor_cleanup verify TERM-ignoring descendant exit after default-grace enclosing timeout/SIGINT/death and direct coordinator death; neither death control supplies the contender assertion. test_helper_timeout_drains_term_ignoring_descendants verifies acknowledged exact-child drain while preserving an unrelated process. Independent-global, failed-subtest, missing-report, import-error/empty inventory and exact deadline/lookalike/shorter-bound assertions remain selected.
